name: Aspirin + Clopidogrel
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: The fixed combination of clopidogrel 75 mg with aspirin 75 or 100 mg is contraindicated in Europe in severe kidney impairment (creatinine clearance [CrCl] below 30 mL/min) because of the aspirin component, and experience in mild to moderate impairment is limited. Clopidogrel's antiplatelet effect is about 25% lower at CrCl 5–15 mL/min. It has no US FDA label.
kidney_function_basis: European summary of product characteristics (SmPC) uses creatinine clearance (CrCl, mL/min).

bands.recommendation: Usual: one tablet once daily (clopidogrel 75 mg with aspirin 75 or 100 mg) (SmPC).
Mild to moderate impairment: limited experience; use with caution and watch for bleeding (SmPC).

Contraindicated: severe kidney impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min), because of the aspirin component (SmPC). Give clopidogrel and low-dose aspirin as separate tablets if dual therapy is needed, with specialist input.

Contraindicated: severe kidney impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min), because of the aspirin component (SmPC). Give clopidogrel and low-dose aspirin as separate tablets if dual therapy is needed, with specialist input.

hd: Contraindicated as the fixed combination (severe kidney impairment). Use separate tablets if dual antiplatelet therapy is indicated; specialist input.
pd: Contraindicated as the fixed combination; use separate tablets if indicated.
monitoring: Bleeding (especially the first month), platelet count (thrombocytopenia, thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura), kidney function (acute kidney injury reported with pre-existing dysfunction). Stop 7 days before surgery if antiplatelet therapy must be interrupted (SmPC 4.4).
